supersession_reason: K6/K7 and routes 4004/4005 were previously used during H01 development, so disjoint predictive membership did not make them prospectively held transport realizations
the proposed carrier-cluster sign test treated candidate ranks sharing the same transport worlds as independent probability units
two observation transport realizations cannot attain a one-sided exact sign-test alpha of 0.01
the observation-pairing null and generation environment were not fully frozen
supersedes: the unexecuted two-K draft; no outcome was read under that draft
purpose: Isolate transport-realization persistence K from placement nuisance U with a disjoint predictive/observation transport split before any M2 or closed-loop claim.

scope.observation_use: held-out observations only, regenerated at U0 rather than reused from diagonal U6/U7 worlds
scope.case_count_formula: 210 carriers * 2 routes * 2 held observation transport keys

placement.definition: for each carrier, use the exact serialized x/y/z coordinate of frozen placement member 0 for every predictive and observation world

reuse.provenance: existing frozen member-0 world at U0

fixed_factorization.existing_diagonal_exclusion_reason: their placements are U1..U7 rather than U0, so reusing any of them would preserve U/K confounding
held_fixed: native GADEN binary and physical equations
source strength and all source parameters
persistent sensor model and initial state

primary_estimand.name: fixed-U transport-coherence source-ordering increment
primary_estimand.coherent: for each candidate and each predictive K in K0..K5, retain that K identity across all visible physical stops, accumulate the whole sequence, then marginalize over the six predictive K
primary_estimand.redraw: at each physical stop independently marginalize or redraw among K0..K5 before sequence accumulation
primary_estimand.observation_generation: each held case is generated coherently from K6 or K7 at the same U0 across all stops
primary_estimand.direction: coherent mean normalized true-carrier midrank must be lower than redraw
primary_estimand.rank_definition: tie-safe exact-equality midrank: 1 + count(score > true_score) + 0.5 * count(false score == true_score)
primary_estimand.carrier_cluster_delta: for each of the 210 carriers, arithmetic mean of its four case-level deltas across route4004/4005 and observation K6/K7
primary_estimand.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test over the 210 carrier-cluster deltas; zero deltas are excluded from the binomial trial count
primary_estimand.case_table_role: all 840 case rows are retained for audit and slice non-reversal only, not treated as independent trials

frozen_score_equations.detection: d[s,K,b] in {0,1} is the frozen M1/M3 detection state for candidate s, predictive transport K, and completed physical stop b
frozen_score_equations.event_probability: p[s,K,b] = (0.5 + d[s,K,b]) / 2, hence p is exactly 0.25 or 0.75
frozen_score_equations.coherent_candidate_score: L_coherent(s) = logmeanexp over K in K0..K5 of [sum over visible completed stops b of ell(y[b], p[s,K,b])]
frozen_score_equations.redraw_candidate_score: L_redraw(s) = sum over visible completed stops b of ell(y[b], mean over K in K0..K5 of p[s,K,b])
frozen_score_equations.candidate_order: descending score; exact-equality ties receive the frozen midrank

families.source_label: permute candidate source labels while keeping candidate coordinates, observations, and all non-label inputs fixed
families.observation_pairing: permute observation-to-stop assignment while preserving each observation tape and its hit count
families.K_identity: destroy persistence of predictive K across stops while preserving K0..K5 and all one-stop marginal information

destruction_controls.null_generation: deterministic permutations frozen by this contract; no outcome-dependent selection
destruction_controls.observed_statistic: mean of the 210 carrier-cluster deltas after first averaging the four route-by-observation case deltas within each carrier
destruction_controls.null_statistic: for each deterministic null replicate, recompute case ranks, average the same four deltas within each carrier, then take the mean across 210 carriers
destruction_controls.p_value_definition: (1 + count(null carrier-clustered statistic >= observed carrier-clustered statistic)) / (256 + 1)
destruction_controls.required_direction: the coherent, correctly labelled, correctly paired statistic must outperform every corresponding destruction family in the preregistered one-sided test

coherent_vs_redraw.cluster_definition: average four frozen route-by-observation normalized-rank deltas per carrier
coherent_vs_redraw.tie_handling: exclude zero carrier-cluster deltas from the exact binomial sign test

slice_nonreversal.rule: mean normalized rank for coherent must be no greater than redraw in every route-by-observation-K slice

forbidden: changing U0 between any K0..K7 world
reusing any existing diagonal K1..K7 world at U1..U7
using K6 or K7 in the predictive ensemble
changing GADEN physics, source strength, wind context, routes, sensor, M1, or M3
temperature, blend weight, adaptive threshold, truth gate, or error gate
source-label or localization-error access before the frozen scoring output exists

interpretation_boundary.pass_supports: H01 fixed-U transport-coherence premise for M2
pass_does_not_support: independent validation of M1 or M3
